summary: Interactive Valentine Quiz Web App: a mobile-first, pastel/romantic interactive love quiz (7 questions) with cute card UI, animations, scoring-based result screens, and an escalating “Yes/No” Valentine button trick ending. No login; shareable link; optional gentle music/sfx. Welcome title text updated to “happy valentine's day dii puna kutty? 💖”; final celebration text includes “diii pondati”.
architectural_notes: Mobile-first single-page web experience with screen-based navigation (welcome → quiz questions → results → valentine trick).
No-auth/shareable-link requirement implies client-side state; consider URL-safe share token only if persistence is needed.
known_issues: Low-score ‘punishment’ text requests a “fit-check video wearing the waist chain… a little naughty”; may be sensitive/sexual content and could require consent/safety review or toned-down alternative.

Spec inconsistency: quiz section says “The Quiz (5 MCQs)” and progress “Question X/5” and perfect-score text “OMG 5/5!!!”, but the quiz lists 7 questions and elsewhere uses 7/7 scoring. Needs alignment (5 vs 7).

Spec changes vs prior state: Welcome title/subtitle text differs; Q3 correct answer now only “Yes babe” (previously included “Defenently honey”); Q6 correct answer now “Ronaldo” (previously “You”); final Valentine celebration text now includes “diii pondati”.

Spec inconsistency/regression: Q6 “Which thing do I love the most?” is shown with TWO correct answers (Ronaldo ✅ and You ✅) in the latest script, but an existing requirement/update (REQ-11) says ONLY “Ronaldo” should be correct. Needs decision (single-correct vs multi-correct) and alignment in scoring/UX.

existing_features.title: Create the app’s overall visual theme and UI system: soft romantic pastel gradients (pinks/beige/blush/red accents), cute rounded cards, subtle shadows, gentle animations, smooth page transitions, playful micro-interactions, and a floating-hearts background layer applied consistently across all screens (mobile-first, responsive).

Implement the Welcome Screen with the exact title, subtitle, and primary CTA: Title “How Well Do You Know Your Husband? 💖”, subtitle “A tiny test made with love just for you”, and a large button labeled “Start the Love Test →” that starts the quiz flow.

Implement the 7-question multiple-choice quiz as a one-question-per-screen flow with: a cute card UI, progress indicator (e.g., “Question X/7” and/or progress bar), interactive hover/press animations on options, and a celebration animation (hearts/confetti) on selecting a correct answer. Add a special sparkle animation when selecting Q4 option “Yes I will😘”.

Hardcode the quiz questions, options, and correct-answer logic exactly as specified (including multi-correct questions):
- Q1 correct: “6th oct 2025”
- Q2 correct: A, B, C, D (all correct)
- Q3 correct: “Yes babe”, “Defenently honey”
- Q4 correct: “Yes I will😘”
- Q5 correct: “Uncountable”, “B”, “C”
- Q6 correct: “You”
- Q7 correct: “You don't love me”

Implement result logic and screens:
- If score is 7/7: show a “winning” result screen with the exact text:
  “OMG 5/5!!! 😭💖

You are officially the BEST WIFE IN THE WORLD.”
  Show a cute romantic/cartoon couple meme image, then show the date-coupon block:
  “🎟 You have won a DATE COUPON!
  Redeemable for: One full day of love, food, cuddles & surprises.”
  Include a button “Redeem My Date 💌”. On click, show the message: “Your husband will contact you shortly for booking 😉”.
- If score < 5: show a teasing (not mean) meme image and the exact text:
  “Hmm… not perfect 👀

You need to do better… but I still love you.”
  Then show: “But you should do the punishment for low score” and continue to the next page to show the punishment text exactly as provided, then proceed to the “Will you still be my Valentine? 💘” step (two buttons Yes/No).

Implement the “Valentine Trick” interaction on the “Will you still be my Valentine? 💘” step: Clicking “No 😈” repeatedly makes the “Yes 💖” button progressively larger and the “No 😈” button progressively smaller, while the prompt text changes in sequence:
- After 1st No: prompt becomes “Are you sure?? 🥺”
- After 2nd No: prompt becomes “You have no escape 😌”
- Continue scaling until “Yes 💖” fills most of the screen and “No 😈” becomes very hard to click.
When “Yes 💖” is clicked, show the final celebration screen with the exact text “YAY!!! You are my Valentine forever 💖🌹” plus confetti + hearts + romantic animation.

Add optional audio (gentle background music and subtle sound effects) with explicit user controls: provide a visible toggle (and/or volume control) that defaults to OFF until the user enables it; ensure audio can be stopped at any time.

Make the experience shareable with no login required: implement a “Copy Link” (or equivalent) share action that copies the current app URL, and ensure the full experience works for any visitor without authentication.

Render required generated images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the result screens (perfect-score meme and low-score teasing meme) without fetching images via the backend.
Update the Welcome screen hero title text to exactly: “happy valentine's day dii puna kutty? 💖” (keep the existing subtitle “A tiny test made with love just for you” and CTA “Start the Love Test →”).

Update the hardcoded quiz questions/options/correctness to match the latest provided script for Q3 and Q6: Q3 options must be exactly [“Nope”, “Yes babe”, “Never”, “Maybee”] with ONLY “Yes babe” marked correct; Q6 options must be exactly [“Myself”, “Ronaldo”, “You”, “Food”] with ONLY “Ronaldo” marked correct.
Update the perfect-score results screen headline text to exactly match the latest script: “OMG 5/5!!! 😭💖” (keep the remainder of the perfect-score screen copy and the date coupon behavior the same).
Update the Punishment screen text to exactly match the latest provided punishment paragraph (including the gift/assumption lines and emojis), preserving line breaks for readability.
Update the final celebration screen main message to exactly: “YAY!!! You are my Valentine forever diii pondati 💖🌹” while keeping the existing confetti/hearts/romantic animation and restart behavior.

Update Quiz Question 6 ("Which thing do I love the most?") so that BOTH options "Ronaldo" and "You" are marked as correct answers (multi-correct), matching the latest provided quiz script, and ensure scoring/celebration behavior treats selecting either correct option as a correct answer.

new_feature_requests.summary: Build Welcome screen with title, subtitle, and “Start the Love Test →” CTA
Implement 7-question MCQ quiz flow (one question per screen) with progress indicator, hover animations, and correct-answer celebration (hearts/confetti)
Implement scoring + result logic with two branches: perfect score reward flow (date coupon + redeem interaction) vs low-score teasing flow with follow-up pages
Implement Valentine “Yes/No” trick interaction: repeated “No” makes Yes grow and No shrink, dynamic prompt text, final Yes celebration with confetti/hearts
Add romantic UI/UX styling: soft pastel gradients, floating hearts background, rounded cards, smooth transitions, micro-interactions; mobile-first responsive design
Optional audio: gentle background music and subtle sound effects with user control
Deployment/usage requirements: shareable link, no login required, keep experience simple and fast
